title: vlm-cpu-benchmark: A Fair CPU-Only Efficiency and Quantization Benchmark for Small Vision-Language Models
description: A reproducible, CPU-only benchmarking framework for small vision-language models. It measures per-inference latency, peak memory, and best-effort RAPL energy on fixed hardware, with each model run through its native preprocessing under identical greedy decoding, across fp32 and custom ONNX INT8 backends, on DocVQA, OCRBench, and a shared binary object-presence task that also compares the VLMs against CPU object detectors in closed- and open-vocabulary regimes. Version 1.1.0 publishes the benchmark data and aligns the description with the method. Accompanies the paper of the same name.
